info.title: appinspector
info.description: Microsoft Application Inspector is a software source code analysis tool that helps identify and surface well-known features and other interesting characteristics of source code to aid in determining what the software is or what it does. This is a dotnet tool package. For the library, see Microsoft.CST.ApplicationInspector.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Inspect source directory/file/compressed file (.tgz|zip) against defined characteristics

options.name: --console-verbosity
options.description: Console verbosity [Verbose|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Fatal] [default: 2]

options.name: --disable-console
options.description: Disable console output of logging messages. [default: False]

options.name: --log-file-level
options.description: Log file level [Verbose|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Fatal] [default: 4]

options.name: --log-file-path
options.description: Log file path. If not set, will not log to file.

options.name: --output-file-path
options.description: Output file path

options.name: --output-file-format
options.description: Output format [json|text] [default: text]

options.name: --custom-rules-path
options.description: Custom rules file or directory path

options.name: --custom-languages-path
options.description: Replace the default languages set with a custom languages.json.

options.name: --custom-comments-path
options.description: Replace the default comment specification set with a custom comments.json.

options.name: --disable-require-unique-ids
options.description: Allow rules with duplicate IDs.

options.name: --success-error-code-with-no-matches
options.description: When processing is apparently successful but there are no matches return a success error code - useful for CI.

options.name: --require-must-match
options.description: When validating, require rules to have MustMatch self-tests.

options.name: --require-must-not-match
options.description: When validating, require rules to have MustNotMatch self-tests.

options.name: --non-backtracking-regex
options.description: Prefer non-backtracking regex for all rules unless they require the backtracking engine. A warning will be displayed for all regular expressions that require backtracking support. Default: Off. [default: False]

options.name: --disable-custom-rule-validation
options.description: By default when providing custom rules they are validated. When set, validation will be skipped.

options.name: --ignore-default-rules
options.description: Exclude default rules bundled with application [default: False]

options.name: --file-timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds to allow for processing each file. 0 is infinity. Default: 60000. [default: 60000]

options.name: --processing-timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds to allow for processing. When NoShowProgress is set this includes enumeration time. 0 is infinity. Default: 0. [default: 0]

options.name: --enumeration-timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds to allow for enumerating. 0 is infinity. Default: 0. [default: 0]

options.name: --disable-archive-crawling
options.description: Disable Archive Enumeration.

options.name: --single-threaded
options.description: Disables parallel processing. May be helpful for debugging with higher verbosity.

options.name: --exclusion-globs
options.description: Exclude source files that match glob patterns. Example: "**/.git/**,*Tests*".  Use "none" to disable. [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --scan-unknown-filetypes
options.description: Scan files of unknown types.

options.name: --confidence-filters
options.description: Output only matches with specified confidence <value>,<value>. Default: Medium,High. [High|Medium|Low] [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --severity-filters
options.description: Output only matches with specified severity <value>,<value>. Default: All are enabled. [Critical|Important|Moderate|BestPractice|ManualReview] [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --source-path
options.description: Source file or directory to inspect, comma separated

options.name: --text-format
options.description: Match text format specifiers [default: Tag:%T,Rule:%N,Ruleid:%R,Confidence:%X,File:%F,Sourcetype:%t,Line:%L,Sample:%m]

options.name: --no-show-progress
options.description: Disable progress information.

options.name: --context-lines
options.description: Number of lines of context on each side to include in excerpt (up to a maximum of 100 * NumLines characters on each side). 0 to skip exerpt. -1 to not extract samples or excerpts (implied by -t). When outputting sarif use -1 for no snippets, all other values ignored.

options.name: --tags-only
options.description: Only get tags (no detailed match data). Ignored if output format is sarif.

options.name: --no-file-metadata
options.description: Don't collect metadata about each individual file.

options.name: --allow-all-tags-in-build-files
options.description: Allow non-Metadata tags from universal rules in Build files. Rules declaring applies_to or applies_to_file_regex are always eligible.

options.name: --max-num-matches-per-tag
options.description: If non-zero, and TagsOnly is not set, will ignore rules based on if all of their tags have been found the set value number of times.

options.name: --base-path
options.description: If set, when outputting sarif, will have paths made relative to the provided path.

options.name: --repository-uri
options.description: If set, override any automatically detected RepositoryUri in Sarif report.

options.name: --commit-hash
options.description: If set, override any automatically detected CommitHash in Sarif report.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
